name: Sync Closed-Won Deals to Supabase pgvector

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { let t = null, src = 'unknown'; try { const f = $('Format Deal Text').first().json; t = f.tenant_id || null; src = f.tenant_source || 'unknown'; } catch (e) { t = null; } const base = { workflow: 'Sync Closed-Won to pgvector', status: $json.delivery.status, lead_name: ($json.lead_name || $json.customer_name || $json.name || null), lead_email: ($json.lead_email || $json.email || null), summary: ('Closed-won deal ' + ($json.dealId || 'unknown') + ' - ' + $json.delivery.note + ($json.delivery.dropped.length ? ': ' + $json.delivery.dropped.join(' | ') : '') + '. Not covered by this check: ' + $json.delivery.not_verified.join('; ') + (t ? ' | tenant: ' + src : ' | TENANT UNRESOLVED')).substring(0, 500), logged_at: $now.toISO() }; return JSON.stringify(t ? Object.assign(base, { tenant_id: t }) : base); })() }}

nodes.name: Verify JWT
nodes.notes: Guard for the public webhook path only. 401 arrives as data because onError = continueRegularOutput.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ deal_id: $json.dealId, customer_name: $json.customer_name, email: $json.email, phone: $json.phone, vehicle: $json.vehicle, amount_aed: $json.amount_aed, purchase_date: $json.purchase_date, lead_id: $json.lead_id }, $json.tenant_id ? { tenant_id: $json.tenant_id } : {})) }}

nodes.name: Lookup Lead By Email
nodes.notes: Runs as the CALLER, not as the service role: anon apikey + the caller's own Authorization header. RLS therefore scopes the result to leads that signed-in user may read.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { return String(($('Verify JWT').first().json || {}).id || ''); } catch (e) { return ''; } })() }}

nodes.name: Auth OK?
nodes.notes: Tenant For JWT User is an HTTP node and REPLACES the item, so the verified user is not on $input -- reach back to Verify JWT by name, wrapped because $() throws when the node did not run.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized', message: 'A valid Supabase session token is required in the Authorization header.' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.notes: Before this node existed the webhook was responseMode:responseNode and the auth check threw, so no Respond node ran and the caller received a bare HTTP 200 with an empty body -- a refusal that looked exactly like a success. Same body and status as Ask-AI's Respond 401.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'Sync Closed-Won to pgvector', status: 'REJECTED', summary: 'Unauthorized closed-won submission rejected | TENANT UNRESOLVED (unauthenticated)', logged_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Audit Rejection
nodes.notes: tenant_id is OMITTED, never sent as null: audit_log.tenant_id is NOT NULL with DEFAULT nexus_default_tenant_id(), which since 5 Sep 2026 is the quarantine tenant. An anonymous caller's refusal is therefore retained and visible to nexus_quarantine_census() instead of being appended to ALBA CARS' audit trail. Copied from Ask-AI's Audit Log, which is the pattern.

activeVersion.name: Tenant-precedence: harden Format Deal Text, raise membership limit
activeVersion.description: Format Deal Text now treats the verified JWT user's tenant_members row as authoritative on the public webhook door and only ever cross-checks a caller-supplied tenant_id claim; the internal/direct-call door keeps its sibling-resolved UUID / sole-configured-tenant fallback. Tenant For JWT User's limit raised 1->2 so multi-membership can be detected and refused. Part of the tenant-precedence wave.
